caption: A stack of newspapers rides a conveyor belt in a printing plant, and when the belt is stopped the stack slides on a little before halting.

sa.check: A stack of newspapers rides a conveyor belt.
The stack slides on a little.
The setting is a printing plant.
The belt stops first and the slide follows.

pc.expect: The slide starts as the belt stops and not before, and the stack stops within a short distance.
pc.fail: It slides while the belt is running steadily; or slides with no stop; or keeps sliding to the end of the belt.

pc.expect: The slide is in the belt's former direction.
pc.fail: It slides backward; or sideways; or the stack lifts off.

pc.expect: The stack stays a stack, shearing a little at most.
pc.fail: The papers fly everywhere; or the stack merges with the belt; or the stack grows.

pc.expect: It stays down on the belt.
pc.fail: It floats; or sinks into the belt; or hangs over the edge unsupported.

pc.expect: One stack and one belt keep their number.
pc.fail: The stack duplicates; or vanishes; or the belt turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The newspapers and the plant stay the same.
pc.fail: The papers change; or the belt changes colour; or the plant rearranges.
